Title: Event Store and Activity Tracking
Content: MemorySmith uses FileEventStore for append-only JSONL event logging. Each MemoryEvent has Action, Details, MemoryId, and Timestamp. Lifecycle events use actions: Created, Updated, Deleted. Search events use actions in the form Query:{kind} (e.g. Query:lexical, Query:semantic, Query:hybrid, Query:context_pack). All four MemoryApplicationService search entry points call RecordQueryEvent at method entry. Older audit logs may still contain Query:keyword from the pre-Lucene default search path. GetActivityBucketsAsync(int days) reads all events since N days ago and groups by UTC date into ActivityBucket records (Date, Queries, Changes). The HealthStats page charts query this to plot 30-day activity. FileEventStore path is configured via MemorySmith:EventLogPath in appsettings (default: ../Data/Events/audit.log). The parent directory is created automatically on startup. FileEventStore.GetEvents supports optional memoryId and since filters for targeted queries.
